name: ZCA_IMPEXP_DIAG_GEN
description: This table contains (import /export /Extn generation) Diagnostic generation.

columns.name: IMPEXP_DIAG_GEN_ID
columns.description: IMPEXP_DIAG_GEN_ID-  the primary key of this table

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONTEXT_BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the Export batch/Import SysTask/ Generation Status

columns.name: DIAGNOSTIC_STATUS
columns.description: STATUS of the current Diagnostic Run

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: This column denotes the Diagnostic Gen Start Time

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: this column denotes the Diagnostic Gen Stop Time

columns.name: MESSAGE
columns.description: This column denotes the Status Message.

columns.name: CONTEXT_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: OBJECT in Export / Import , Application  in GENERATE

columns.name: CONTEXT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Export Batch Id / Import Systask Id / Impexp_extn_gen_id - To maintain relation between components and generation record

columns.name: CONTEXT_JOB_ID
columns.description: This column denotes Export Job Id/Import Job Id
